playbookSettings.execution.fields.maxToo: Maximum model-to-tool rounds allowed inside one node task before it returns a bounded stop response.
playbookSettings.execution.fields.graphC: Caches compiled playbook graphs between runs. Toggling this setting clears entries created under the previous policy.

guardrails.description: Set organization-wide blocking for prompt injection, data leakage, and risky tool usage.

guardrails.classifierActive: Classifier model active: {{name}}. Configure it from Admin > Models with type guardrails_classifier.

guardrails.outputGuardrailDescription: Blocks final answers that leak instructions, follow unsafe overrides, or expose sensitive information.
guardrails.toolCallGuardrailDescription: Stores the policy for risky tool usage such as destructive actions, external calls, or data exfiltration.

conversationSettings.title: Conversation Settings
conversationSettings.description: Control global conversation behavior without redeploying the application.
conversationSettings.suggestions.title: Composer Suggestions
conversationSettings.suggestions.descrip: Configure the AI assistance shown while users draft a message.
conversationSettings.enabled.label: Enable composer suggestions
conversationSettings.enabled.description: When disabled, clients stop requesting suggestions and the API rejects direct requests.
conversationSettings.agent.label: Suggestion agent
conversationSettings.agent.description: Only active default agents are available. Automatic prefers the Suggestions agent and then falls back to another active default agent.
conversationSettings.debounce.label: Debounce delay (ms)
conversationSettings.debounce.descriptio: Wait time after typing before requesting a suggestion. Allowed: 250-2000.
conversationSettings.minimumLength.label: Minimum draft length
conversationSettings.minimumLength.descr: Minimum trimmed characters required before suggestions run. Allowed: 3-200.
conversationSettings.rateLimit.label: Requests per minute
conversationSettings.rateLimit.descripti: Maximum suggestion requests per user and application instance. Allowed: 1-120.
conversationSettings.maxTokens.label: Maximum output tokens
conversationSettings.maxTokens.descripti: Token ceiling sent to the suggestion model. Allowed: 32-1024.
conversationSettings.validation.bounds: Enter whole numbers within the allowed ranges before saving.
conversationSettings.toasts.saved.title: Conversation settings updated
conversationSettings.toasts.saved.descri: The new settings apply to conversation composers.
menu.evaluationSettings.label: Evaluation settings
evaluationSettings.title: Evaluation settings
evaluationSettings.description: Configure evidence-based reliability checks for completed AI answers.
evaluationSettings.enableDescription: Evaluate completed answers and optionally correct material reliability issues.
evaluationSettings.informativeDescriptio: Answers are displayed immediately. Reliability is evaluated afterward and never blocks or changes the generated response.
evaluationSettings.correctiveTransparent: Display the answer immediately, then correct it when verification identifies material issues.
evaluationSettings.correctiveGuardedDesc: Verify and correct the answer before publication.
evaluationSettings.scope: Applies to legacy Conversation only. Conversation V2 is not included.
evaluationSettings.noModel: No active compatible judge model is available. Activate a chat model in Admin > Models.
evaluationSettings.concurrencyHelp: Maximum evaluations per backend instance for this MVP.
evaluationSettings.timeoutHelp: Affects only the evaluator, never the original answer.
evaluationSettings.maxFindingsHelp: Limits the attention summary. All evaluated claims remain available for correction and audit.
evaluationSettings.correction.title: Transparent correction
evaluationSettings.correction.thresholdH: Scores below this value trigger correction. Critical unsupported or conflicting claims always trigger it.
evaluationSettings.correction.maxAttempt: One attempt is recommended for this MVP.
evaluationSettings.correction.attemptWar: Additional attempts increase latency and model usage.
evaluationSettings.correction.showOrigin: Allow users to view the original answer after correction or abstention. The original answer is always retained internally.
evaluationSettings.fixedBehavior: The evaluator uses only evidence attached to the answer. It does not browse the web, rerun retrieval, or use the judge model's general knowledge as proof.
